How this tier list works

The list is calculated from 232 710 ranked battles. Every brawler gets a score from 0 to 10, where win rate counts for 90% and use rate for 10%, and the maps a brawler is played on most weigh more. Showdown and some modes are not in Ranked, their numbers come from 593 021 trophy battles.

Right now Mr. P leads the ranked meta with a 58.6% win rate and a 2.7% use rate.

The highest win rate belongs to Mr. P with 58.6%, currently in tier S+.

What the tiers mean

S+
The very top of the meta. These brawlers have the highest score by win rate and pick rate on the maps where they are played.
S
The strongest picks of the current meta, by win rate and pick rate on the maps where they are played.
A
Great brawlers that win reliably, slightly behind the top of the meta.
B
Solid picks that shine on the right maps.
C
Average brawlers. Playable, but other picks usually do the same job better.
D
Weak in the current meta. Worth it only on maps that suit them.

Frequently asked questions

Which maps have the most ranked battles and who is best on them?
Most ranked battles are played on Goldarm Gulch, Hideout, Flowing Springs. On Goldarm Gulch the strongest brawlers right now are Edgar, Pearl, Mr. P.
Which Brawl Stars maps are in the ranked stats?
The page covers maps of knockout, bounty, brawlBall, gemGrab, heist, hotZone, soloShowdown, trioShowdown, duoShowdown, airHockey, brawlBall5V5, brawlArena, basketBrawl, deathmatch5v5, deathmatch, knockout5V5, 102 maps in total.
Why is the order on a map different from the overall tier list?
A map's letters and numbers are counted only from battles on that map, ranked ones or, for maps marked Trophy battles, trophy battles. A brawler who is average overall can be one of the best on a map that suits them, and the other way round.
